scripts.test: npm run test:integration && npm run test:challenges && npm run check:packaging
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix packages/participant-ticket test && npm --prefix apps/portal test && npm run test:operator && npm run check:packaging
scripts.test:challenges: npm --prefix apps/reward-sniper test && npm --prefix apps/imprint/web test && npm --prefix apps/silent-patch test && npm --prefix apps/overclock test && npm --prefix apps/last-stop test && npm --prefix apps/after-hours test
scripts.test:onchain: npm --prefix apps/imprint test && npm --prefix apps/silent-patch run test:onchain
scripts.build:web: npm run build:portal && npm run build:imprint-web
scripts.verify:portal: npm run test:integration && npm run build:portal
